## Social cards for a deck

The filter reads the standard Quarto social metadata in this document's front matter and writes the corresponding tags into the head.

View the source of this page, and the head carries `og:url`, `og:type`, and the image dimensions, alongside the tags Quarto writes itself.

## Absolute image URLs

Scrapers need an absolute `og:image` URL, so set `site-url` and let relative image paths resolve against it.

The filter warns when a relative path is used without one.

## More

Anything the standard keys cannot express is set under `extensions.social`.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-revealjs-social/>.
